scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n backend,frontend,electron -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev --workspace=electron"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.build:electron: npm run build && npm run build --workspace=electron
